ECO-SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE

Built for Speed. Engineered for Sustainability.

Verdis redefines Layer-1 infrastructure with energy-efficient consensus, automatic carbon credit routing, and real-time environmental logging.

Green DPoS Consensus

Delegated Proof-of-Stake algorithm engineered for sub-second block finality while consuming 99.99% less energy than traditional networks.

Carbon Credit NFTs

Native tokenization of certified carbon credits directly on-chain, providing fractionalized, liquid, and transparent eco-offsets.

Eco AMM DEX

High-efficiency automated market maker featuring zero-slippage green liquidity pools with automated tree-planting fee distribution.

Sustainable Smart Contracts

Rust and EVM-compatible execution layer optimized for low gas fees and minimal computational overhead.

Green Validator Network

Strict proof-of-clean-energy verification ensuring 100% of network validators run exclusively on certified renewable energy sources.

Reforestation Logging

Direct integration with Sentinel-2 satellite feeds to record immutable, real-time biomass growth and tree planting coordinates on-chain.

HOW IT WORKS

The Carbon Negative Protocol Flow

Every transaction executed on Verdis generates micro-contributions that directly fund global reforestation.

01
⚡

Ultra-Low Energy Execution

User submits a transaction. Green DPoS validators reach consensus in 400ms consuming < 0.00012 kWh of clean energy.

02
♻️

Automated Carbon Route

1% of gas fees are automatically routed into the Green Treasury smart contract to purchase verified carbon offsets.

03
🛰️

Satellite Biomass Proof

Satellite feeds verify tree planting growth. The network mints immutable Green Proof NFTs directly to the user's wallet.
